title: OurEventRing Aggregate Intelligence Layer Schema
description: The fourth layer. De-identified, aggregated contributions flow here from the active source pools. This is what the RAG reads. This is where cross-pool community intelligence lives. No PII, no PHI, no individual minor data. Corridor-level behavioral density only. NOTE: HIPAA and COPPA are declined regimes (OCR_STANDARD_declinedRegimes.md, ratified 2026-09-04; OSE-1220) — only the 'general' pool is an active contributor. The hipaa/coppa source_pool entries and the de_identification_audit table are retained as records of refusal, not active pipelines.

general.description: Anonymous data is already de-identified at collection. No transformation required. Flows directly to aggregate tables.

hipaa.declined_by: OCR_STANDARD_declinedRegimes.md (ratified 2026-09-04). HIPAA is a declined regime — no OCR product writes to oureventring_hipaa, so no HIPAA data ever contributes to the aggregate layer. Retained as a record of what is refused, NOT an active contribution path (OSE-1220).
hipaa.description: Inactive — never runs because HIPAA is declined. Would have stripped all 18 Safe Harbor identifiers, leaving only corridor-level behavioral signal, minimum group size 5.

coppa.declined_by: OCR_STANDARD_declinedRegimes.md (ratified 2026-09-04). COPPA under-13 child data is a declined regime — no OCR product writes to oureventring_coppa, so no COPPA data ever contributes to the aggregate layer. Retained as a record of what is refused, NOT an active contribution path (OSE-1220).
coppa.description: Inactive — never runs because COPPA is declined. Would have required no individual minor identifiable, minimum group size 10, sub-threshold events suppressed entirely.

corridor_intelligence.description: The primary table the RAG queries. Cross-pool corridor-level behavioral density, computed daily from all three source pools after de-identification.

fields.name: total_events
fields.description: Sum across all contributing pools.

fields.name: category_distribution
fields.description: Event count by category_id. Cross-pool aggregate.

fields.name: product_distribution
fields.description: Event count by product_id.

fields.name: pool_contribution_flags
fields.description: Which pools contributed data for this corridor on this date. Only 'general' is an active pool; HIPAA and COPPA are declined regimes (OSE-1220) and never contribute. Example: {general: true}. Does NOT reveal counts per pool — only presence.

fields.name: day_of_week
fields.description: For weekly pattern detection (Thursday density, weekend patterns).

fields.name: is_recurring_dominant
fields.description: Whether >50% of events were recurring instances.

fields.name: sponsor_presence
fields.description: Whether any sponsored events occurred. No sponsor identity.

trend_signals.description: Derived trend signals computed by Vertex AI (Phase 5). Week-over-week and month-over-month changes in corridor behavior.

fields.name: signal_type
fields.description: growth, decline, emergence, migration, seasonal_shift, venue_gap.

fields.name: category_id
fields.description: Relevant event category, if signal is category-specific.

fields.name: magnitude
fields.description: Strength of signal (0.0 to 1.0).

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Model confidence (0.0 to 1.0).

fields.name: lookback_days
fields.description: How many days of data the signal is computed from.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Human-readable signal description for SharedReport rendering.

venue_gap_analysis.description: Identifies corridors where demand exists but venue supply doesn't. Premium tier insight.

fields.name: category_id
fields.description: Which event category has unmet demand.

fields.name: demand_score
fields.description: Computed demand from scan patterns and cross-corridor comparison.

fields.name: nearest_supply_corridor
fields.description: Closest corridor that has this category served.

fields.name: recommendation
fields.description: Human-readable recommendation for SharedReport.

de_identification_audit.declined_by: OCR_STANDARD_declinedRegimes.md (ratified 2026-09-04). This audit table exists only for the HIPAA/COPPA de-identification pipeline. Both are declined regimes — no data ever flows from those pools, so no audit rows are ever written. Retained as a record of the refused pipeline, not an active table (OSE-1220).
de_identification_audit.description: INACTIVE. Would have been the audit trail proving that data flowing from the HIPAA and COPPA pools was properly stripped before entering the aggregate layer. Since HIPAA and COPPA are declined (OSE-1220), no such data flows and this table is never populated.

fields.name: source_pool
fields.description: Would be 'hipaa' or 'coppa'. Both are declined regimes (OSE-1220); no rows are ever written.

fields.name: source_record_count
fields.description: Records processed in this batch.

fields.name: records_contributed
fields.description: Records that passed de-identification and threshold checks.

fields.name: records_suppressed
fields.description: Records suppressed due to group size threshold.

rag_access_rules.description: Rules governing how the RAG (Vertex AI) queries this layer.
rules: RAG reads ONLY from oureventring_aggregate. Never from raw pools.
RAG cannot query by institution_id, baa_entity_id, or any identifier stripped during de-identification.
RAG outputs (trend signals, venue gaps, recommendations) are tagged with confidence scores.
Premium tier customers see RAG outputs in SharedReports. Free and Mid do not.
RAG outputs never reveal which raw pool contributed a specific data point. pool_contribution_flags show presence only, not counts.
All RAG queries are logged for audit purposes.
